id.description: Positive BIGINT UNSIGNED ID as exact base-10 text, range 1?18446744073709551615, without leading zeros. Never convert to JavaScript Number or PHP float. Pattern enforces the storage range; the server also enforces scoped reference existence and authorization. Human document references and public operation IDs are distinct types.

verified_at.description: UTC DATETIME(6) wire instant, six fractional digits and Z. Enable date-time format assertion in validators. Display in Asia/Manila while retaining the UTC value; deadlines use elapsed time (48 hours is 172800 seconds), never a local calendar-day substitution. JavaScript Date is only millisecond-precise: it may format a display, but retain the original six-place string for identity, exact comparison and fingerprinting.
